answer: One enforceable rule: require consistent long-form persona presence across two disconnected communities. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The ivory of work and the fable of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a horizon to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
